scientific_rationale: Evaluation pipeline completed successfully without model refitting or data leakage. However, out of 167 evaluation snapshots across 89 cases, only 4 observed events occurred (2 in SECTION_11_TO_SECTION_19, 0 in SECTION_19_TO_AWARD, 2 in CASE_INITIATION_TO_MILESTONE). Consequently, event-based discrimination cannot be established for SECTION_19_TO_AWARD, and time-dependent discrimination metrics across all horizons lack statistical reliability.
